description: How orc people talk to the captain at a station.

or-back: You still have your ship! Good!
I told them you'd be back.
Come, tell me you've fought something.
or-heard: I heard it over the engines:
A big fellow told me that
or-coda: Sounds like trouble. I like trouble.
That's the news, and it's good enough.
no-rumour: Nothing! Dull as a cold forge!
No news. I'd start one if I could.
or-lead: Here is a thing worth doing:
or-workcoda: Pay is good. Don't be slow!
Take it before someone bigger does.
no-work: Nothing! Go pick a fight and come back.
self: {role}, and the best on this station! #or-life#
or-life: I've worked for {faction}, and I've outlasted three of their bosses.
I broke a door once. It hasn't forgiven me.
{system} is loud, and so am I.
I could lift this table, and the man under it.
My clan would be proud, or at least loud.
or-toast: To a loud death, a long way off!
To {system}, and the fools in it!
drink-again: No! If I drink again I'll fight the wall!
Save it! I'll buy the next one.
One's plenty. I'm still standing, aren't I?
Not twice! I have a reputation for holding my drink.
pestered: Enough! You ask like a customs officer!
You talk more than I do, and I'm loud!
Stop it, or I'll hold you by the boots.
My ears are tired. Ask someone else.
cold: I don't like you. Go away.
Say nothing. I'm not interested in your voice.
haggle-yes: Ha! You ask like a warrior! {fact}!
or-grudge: No one asks that loudly. Done.
haggle-no: No! But I like your nerve.
Never! Ask again and I'll respect you more, and still say no.
No. You've got guts, I'll say that.
haggle-offended: You insult me. Take your face elsewhere.
I said no. Do you want to fight? The job's gone.
Bah! That's the end of it.
